notes.title: Hexalert 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068053/4fac320e0d2ed06fbb08a375dff31dfc40d60dc8.png[/img]
Hexalert patch 1.2 contains:
Fixes for various bugs.
Updated keybinds allowing for quickly changing your units weapon with "Q" or utility with "E".
Updated pause menu.
Added [b]ingame music player[/b] with two new songs.

Also with this patch Hexalert contains support for [b]Linux![/b]
